Zambian Firm Unveils Innovative Ore Processing Technology

Lusaka – A new chapter in Zambia’s mining sector was marked on Tuesday following the official launch of an advanced ore processing system by KwachaMetals Limited, a leading local mining technology provider. The event, held at the company’s Chingola facility, drew mining executives, government representatives, and industry analysts keen on the promise of greater efficiency and sustainability for the nation’s metals and mining industry.

The newly unveiled “CopperMax Pro” system is designed to increase copper recovery rates while reducing environmental impact. According to KwachaMetals, the technology utilizes a proprietary combination of flotation and leaching techniques that boost ore yields by up to 12% while minimizing water and chemical consumption.

“The CopperMax Pro system is a proud milestone for Zambian innovation in mining,” said KwachaMetals CEO Natasha Banda during the launch. “It responds to the growing need for efficient resource utilization and aligns with Zambia’s vision for value addition in the extractive sector.”

Zambia, Africa’s second-largest copper producer, has been seeking ways to modernize its mining operations amid fluctuating global commodity prices and rising pressure to adhere to environmental best practices. Industry experts say that homegrown technological advancements could help the country maintain its competitive edge.

“The introduction of this technology is timely,” commented Samuel Mwale, an analyst at the Zambia Chamber of Mines. “It’s encouraging to see local firms leading the development of solutions that can enhance both productivity and environmental stewardship.”

The CopperMax Pro system is set to be deployed at several partner mining sites in the Copperbelt Province over the next year. KwachaMetals estimates that full-scale adoption could increase national copper output by as much as 30,000 metric tonnes annually.

Minister of Mines and Minerals Development, Hon. Felix Mbewe, praised the initiative, stating, “This launch demonstrates the capability of Zambian enterprises to innovate for the future. We are committed to supporting such efforts that strengthen our mining sector and create more opportunities for Zambians.”

Industry observers will be closely watching the rollout of CopperMax Pro, with hopes that it sets a benchmark for technology-driven growth across Zambia’s mining landscape.
